stories.title: Doomscrolling too much? Try these tips to put the phone down and plug into real life
stories.summary: NPR Life Kit's Marielle Segarra provides tips to help you reduce your screentime.

stories.title: Arizona students show love for their teachers
stories.summary: As students across the country celebrate teachers and school staff, some thoughtful learners in Arizona articulate why they appreciate theirs.

stories.title: Wisconsin residents hold 'caravans of love' to celebrate mothers in prison
stories.summary: A group of Wisconsinites organizes a "headlight caravan" outside a local women's prison. It's a show of solidarity for the women inside the prison to let them know they're not forgotten.

stories.title: Passengers on the cruise ship struck by a Hantavirus outbreak flown to home countries
stories.summary: The passengers from the MV Hondius, the cruise ship at the center of the recent Hantavirus outbreak, are being evacuated - and flown home to their respective countries.

stories.title: Florida farmers struggle to adapt as disease and climate take toll on citrus industry
stories.summary: Florida's citrus industry is in deep decline and growers are trying to hang on as they find ways to withstand disease and disasters.

stories.title: Diving deep into the fascinating history of America's jaywalking laws
stories.summary: Jaywalking is often considered to be a pretty minor offense, but it is illegal in many American cities. KCUR's Mackenzie Martin offers a history of America's jaywalking laws.
